info.title: Web Fetch API
info.description: Fetch a URL as Markdown, HTML, plain text, links, or the raw response, plus metadata. Bypasses bot protection, rate limits, and browser-based challenges.

get.description: Fetches the resource at the URL and returns its content converted to requested formats plus metadata. Choose `POST` instead of query params to send a JSON request body.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The URL to fetch. Only `http://` and `https://` schemes are supported; others are rejected. Only `url` is required.

parameters.name: formats
parameters.description: Select one or more formats: `markdown`, `html`, `text`, `links`, `raw`. If omitted, defaults to `markdown` for HTML/PDF, `text` for text-based content, or `raw` for images, archives, and other binary content.

parameters.name: unwrap
parameters.description: By default, the endpoint returns a JSON object with a field for each requested format, such as `markdown`. Set `unwrap=true` to return the first producible of the requested `formats` directly as the HTTP response body; `raw` works for any content type, so listing it last guarantees a response. Defaults to `false`.

parameters.name: headers
parameters.description: Extra HTTP headers to send with the request, as a JSON string. For example: `{"Accept-Language":"fr-FR"}`.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Milliseconds to wait after the page loads, for content that shows up late. From 1 to 60000. Setting it renders the page in a real browser, so content loaded by JavaScript is included. Rendered requests are slower.

post.description: Fetches the resource at the URL and returns its content converted to requested formats plus metadata.

url.description: The URL to fetch. Only `http://` and `https://` schemes are supported; others are rejected.

formats.description: The Actor converts the fetched content to the requested format(s). A format that doesn't apply to the content type returns `null`; if none of the requested formats apply, the request fails with `UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT_TYPE`. If omitted, defaults to `markdown` for HTML/PDF, `text` for text-based content, or `raw` for images, archives, and other binary content. Composes freely with `unwrap`.

unwrap.description: By default, the endpoint returns a JSON object with a field for each requested format, such as `markdown`. Set `unwrap=true` to return the first producible of the requested `formats` directly as the HTTP response body; `raw` works for any content type, so listing it last guarantees a response. Defaults to `false`.

headers.description: Custom HTTP headers to send to the target URL, as an object of header names and values, e.g. `{ "Accept-Language": "fr-FR", "Authorization": "Bearer TARGET_SITE_TOKEN" }`.

wait.description: Milliseconds to wait after the page loads, for content that shows up late. From 1 to 60000. Setting it renders the page in a real browser, so content loaded by JavaScript is included. Rendered requests are slower.
